name: Leffingite
description: The Leffingites were a sentient species from the planet Almak. They were characterized by a tall, narrow head; a large, flat nose with two gaping nostrils; two large, fan-like ears; and large jaws from which protruded a smattering of small teeth. Four brown horns extended from above their goggle eyes; two of these growths were relatively short, while two others were longer. The head extended at a perpendicular angle to the body and was covered in loose, wrinkled skin.
